text_block_list.text:
D-Duramente-san! May I ask you one 
thing... !?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You've been using the training machine way 
in the back lately, right? Rumor has it 
that a ghost appears there at night, so—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? I-I'm so sorry for bringing up 
such a boring topic~~!!
